claim: The WebFetchTool/WebSearchTool family, HTTP client and proxy setup, HTML conversion, and Bing/DDG parsing live in tools/web.rs. The process-wide reqwest Client and connection pool are reused while OWO_HTTP_PROXY is unchanged, then rebuilt on configuration changes. Invalid proxy errors never echo the proxy URL, which may contain credentials. ToolSpec/ToolContext/ToolRegistry and original registration remain in tools.rs.
